about_short_description.short_description: Flutter.io is a new project to helps developers build high performance, mobile apps for iOS, and Android from a single codebase.

product.name: Flutter Framework
product.description: A UI toolkit for building natively compiled applications for mobile, web, and desktop from a single codebase.

product.name: Dart
product.description: A programming language optimized for building fast apps on any platform, powering the Flutter framework.

product.name: Hot Reload
product.description: A feature that allows developers to see changes in their code almost instantly without losing the current state of the app.

product.name: Multi-Platform Deployment
product.description: Enables deployment of applications to mobile, web, desktop, and embedded devices from a single codebase.

product.name: DevTools
product.description: A suite of performance and debugging tools for Flutter applications, including widget and layout inspectors, network and memory profilers.

product.name: Google Integrations
product.description: Seamless integration with Google services like Firebase, Google Ads, Google Play, Google Pay, Google Wallet, and Google Maps.
